text.p: Wall Street moved higher at Wednesday's opening, weighed somewhat by record durable goods data and still digesting a rise in interest rates.
The Dow Industrials were up 5.29 at 6881.46 and the Nasdaq Composite was up 4.54 at 1252.60.
The commerce department earlier reported that orders for costly manufactured goods posted a surprisingly strong gain last month, hitting record levels after a robust January.
